Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) demonstrates a large, irregular mass in the right mid-lung zone with central lucency indicative of cavitation. This finding of multiple or solitary nodules/masses with irregular margins and cavitation is a classic radiographic manifestation of the necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis seen in Wegener's granulomatosis (Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis).
